dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to go fishing too!

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: You have far more important things to do.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: You don't want to follow in my footsteps. I'm just waiting around for my life to come to an end.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Reason being, I did what I had to do, and now it's done.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did you have to do?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: I think you already know the answer to that. Because like you, I used to be one of the chosen ones in this world.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: The difference is, I used my power to do some bad things.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: I gave up my Vision. I'm not worthy of it anymore, nor do I have any real use for it.
